DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypertrophic Pyloric Stenosis.

Please note that intussusception is unlikely at 8 months of age as a primary cause of these specific feeding issues without a history of prior illness or trauma; the classic "olive" mass and projectile non-bilious vomiting strongly suggest pyloric stenosis. I will proceed with an upper GI series to confirm the diagnosis.
